summary: Lithium Argentina AG filed a Form 6-K containing notice of its annual meeting and management information circular for June 19, 2026. Shareholders will vote on routine matters: approving financial statements, director elections, auditor appointments, equity plan amendments, executive compensation, and Swiss statutory items. No M&A, restructuring, or special situation is present. The filing is a standard periodic proxy solicitation for a foreign private issuer, with no event-driven catalyst or transactional element.
